name: Lee Moor Clay Works
blurb: A china clay pit on south-west Dartmoor: white spoil tips, a green flooded floor and a pony or two in trouble.

stages: Bare white spoil and a dry pit.
Heather taking; the pit floods green.
Heath and pools; ponies and pixies.

ranger: White spoil and a dry pit. Eighty years of china clay left this. Do be careful of the edge.
Topsoil's down and the gorse is sown. It looks like a building site that has forgotten what for.
Heather's taking, and the pit is flooding green. The ponies have started to come down.
Heath and pools, ponies grazing the rim. Some locals swear they've seen pixies. I don't ask.
